additional_info.subject: Issue description
additional_info.body:
can you please check on charger MP / NN 170000045 where we face the
following issue?
2025-10-06T05:18:07.642500+00:00 -> PLC-Error-Flag
'DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100' initial value true - (VIV:0 PLE:1 KON:1)
Transaction started
2025-10-06T05:15:45.345229+00:00 -> DC1: PilotState "B2" --> "C2"
Immediately before error we were delivering 142 kW to the EV. Note that
the ambient temperature during that time could be around 10 °C maximum
2025-10-06T05:18:07.921311+00:00 -> |ID=137|DC1:
|EVSE_MaxPwr[kW]=169|EVSE_MaxCur[A]=400|EVSE_NowPwr[kW]=142.4

additional_info.body:
Dear Meghna,
Would you happen to have any updates regarding this case and case ID0453763?
It looks like in both cases we face an issue with CCS cable feedback.
Thank you for checking, since this charger can´t be operated reliably anymore.
Kind regards,
Milan

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0453772-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / NN 170000045] Voltage issue CRM:02698000603
additional_info.body:
Dear Milan,
After checking the charger we see multiple error codes 4 and 5.
These errors are :
Errorcode 4: Outlet not ready - charging cable temperature sensor error,
Errorcode 5: Outlet not ready - HPC charging cable cooling error
Please check the connector XD10 and XD12. If the problem remains,  proceed to replace the plug.
I will send this ticket to your queue for the onsite activity.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Laura Martins,
Please do not change the subject of this email when replying to it.
